name_boundary: DeepCoder-HO is a local working label for this strict higher-order compatibility subset; it is not an official ExeDec split or benchmark name.

source.paper: Shi et al., ExeDec: Execution Decomposition for Compositional Generalization in Neural Program Synthesis, ICLR 2024
source.attribution_note: Generated debug bundles must retain the repository, paper citation, commit, and license fields.

supported_subset.source_shape: one List<Int> input; exactly x1 = Filter P x0 followed by x2 = Map M x1; linear data flow and distinct variables
supported_subset.translation: Filter becomes the FoldRight condition; Map becomes the retained PrependInt head; the empty list is the initial value; order is preserved.
excluded: division lambdas because the current typed AST has no floor-division node
even and odd predicates because the current typed AST has no modulo node
Count, ZipWith, Scanl1, and every first-order DeepCoder operation
multiple inputs, branching data flow, scalar inputs, and local-variable states
arbitrary DeepCoder programs and the RobustFill domain

released_debug_audit.interpretation: Occurrence counts are not independent tasks. Public target and few-shot programs are contamination evidence, so all adapted released tasks are debug-only.

hidden_semantic_evaluation.classification: provider-private debug oracle, not a secret or confirmatory oracle
hidden_semantic_evaluation.source_semantics: independent direct Filter/Map evaluation with DeepCoder's inclusive [-50,50] result validation
hidden_semantic_evaluation.fixed_probes: empty list and every target-defined singleton in [-50,50]
hidden_semantic_evaluation.seeded_probes: 128 unique target-defined lists by default, lengths 2 through 5, cycling the official value ranges [0,4], [0,9], [-10,10], and [-50,50]
hidden_semantic_evaluation.undefined_target_inputs: excluded because the DeepCoder DSL is partial outside executions whose intermediate and final values validate
hidden_semantic_evaluation.candidate_interpreter: the existing modelsmc_pbe typed interpreter and scorer
hidden_semantic_evaluation.acceptance: exact output equality on every stored hidden probe
hidden_semantic_evaluation.behavioral_scope: singleton coverage is complete for source programs in this pointwise order-preserving subset; finite multi-list probes do not establish equivalence for arbitrary candidate ASTs

contamination_and_collision_policy.released_source_binding: fail if the exact JSONL SHA-256 differs from the pinned commit
contamination_and_collision_policy.within_split_deduplication: group by partial behavior on every singleton in the full [-50,50] scalar domain, including undefined outcomes, and select the lowest source index
contamination_and_collision_policy.released_registry: scan target and few-shot programs in every released DeepCoder test_data and llm_data JSONL; fail a future candidate whose complete-singleton semantic fingerprint occurs
contamination_and_collision_policy.local_registry_requirement: before any future confirmatory generation, separately bind and scan all project tasks, pilot targets, prompt fixtures, and prior provider-visible programs; this cross-DSL local scan is not yet implemented
contamination_and_collision_policy.model_training_contamination: cannot be ruled out for any released task, even when a syntax pair is absent from the repository's released JSONL

claim_limits: This adapter establishes format and semantic compatibility only.
It does not reproduce ExeDec, its learned decomposition method, or its reported train/test evaluation.
It does not test the official compositional-generalization estimand because the current target collapses a two-line source program into one filter-map skeleton.
It does not support a claim about all DeepCoder higher-order operations or the full DeepCoder DSL.
Released-task success cannot be called blind, contamination-free, confirmatory, out-of-distribution, or evidence of external-benchmark generalization.
Equal logical executions would not imply equal wall-clock time, provider compute, or total compute.
No SMC accuracy, discovery, speedup, LLM advantage, or semantic-equivalence result exists until a separately frozen run is executed.
